project.scope: The project directory and CASA's file stem <project>.<configuration>; a nested project path is named by its last component (decision).

skymodel.scope: An image model, rewritten by modifymodel and flattened; a model that is the <stem>.skymodel the task writes is refused (decision).

inbright.scope: Rescales the model's peak, as CASA does.

incell.scope: Sets the model's cell; two cells are taken as given (decision in simutil).

complist.scope: A component list, alone or with a sky model; with a calibrator both lists are predicted (decision).

compwidth.scope: The bandwidth of a component-only model.

comp_nchan.scope: The channels of a component-only model.

setpointings.scope: Lays the pointings out, or reads ptgfile.

ptgfile.scope: CASA's pointing file, read or written.

integration.scope: The integration time; one summing to zero pointing time is refused (decision).

direction.scope: The map centre, or a list of pointings; a list of one is rounded to its mean as CASA does (decision).

pointingspacing.scope: The spacing, or a fraction of the primary beam.

obsmode.scope: 'int', 'sd', or '' to corrupt an existing MeasurementSet.

totaltime.scope: The total time; a pass the time does not complete is observed in part (decision).

antennalist.scope: An interferometer configuration file or an ALMA resolution string.

outframe.scope: The spectral frame written. LSRK, TOPO, BARY, LSRD, GEO, GALACTO, LGROUP and CMB have scoped CASA task comparisons; REST and Undefined and combinations with other observation modes remain unverified.

thermalnoise.scope: 'tsys-atm', 'tsys-manual' or '' noise through the simulator's setnoise.

seed.scope: The random seed; casa-rs's draws differ from CASA's.

correlator.scope: The correlator efficiency passed to noisetemp.

graphics.scope: Interferometric file/screen/both writes the numerical .quick.psf before corruption, using legacy single-field padding 1.0. PNG rendering remains unfinished and warns (#1025); none and single-dish do not write a quick PSF.

overwrite.scope: Replaces the project's products; without it an existing MeasurementSet is refused with CASA's message.

Additional combinations (such as overrides with combined image/component input and multi-channel image models) remain outside this receipt; the behavior remains Partial.

decisions.record: An unset `compwidth` gives the component-only model a meaningless spectral increment
decisions.inputs: simobserve with a component list, no sky image and compwidth=''.
decisions.casa: It observes 2 GHz when compwidth is not a quantity, but sets the .compskymodel spectral increment from compwidth anyway, yielding a meaningless value (the RA in radians read as hertz, 4.976 Hz for RA 19h, in CASA 6.7.6).
decisions.ours: Uses the 2 GHz simobserve observes with.
decisions.rationale: The increment is the model's only spectral information beyond its reference frequency.
decisions.impact: The component-only model carries a consistent spectral increment.
decisions.owner_decision: Standing rule, AGENTS.md "CASA deviations" (owner, #1054): where CASA crashes, aborts, reads out of bounds, loses or corrupts data, or contradicts its documentation or evident intent, casa-rs corrects it.

decisions.record: simobserve's calibrator: the last pass, its scans and two component lists
decisions.inputs: simobserve with a phase calibrator (caldirection and calflux), also with a complist or totaltime ending inside a pass.
decisions.casa: CASA 6.7.6 never observes the pointings of an incomplete last pass (a 300 s total on 105 pointings has only the calibrator's scan), selects fields range(0,nfld) so the calibrator's scans keep zeros plus noise, and joins component lists into one nonexistent table so predict returns False.
decisions.ours: Observes the pointings the time allows, predicts every scan including the calibrator's, and predicts both lists as one list of their components.
decisions.rationale: The task means to observe and predict all of these.
decisions.impact: CASA data can lack pointings, have unpredicted calibrator scans, or be all zero; casa-rs data are complete (parity cases agree at 5e-9 NRMS).
decisions.owner_decision: Standing rule, AGENTS.md "CASA deviations" (owner, #1054): where CASA crashes, aborts, reads out of bounds, loses or corrupts data, or contradicts its documentation or evident intent, casa-rs corrects it.

decisions.inputs: simobserve with tsys-atm noise set after leakage (the noisier measurement set).
decisions.casa: The setnoise table is written beside the noisy MeasurementSet, and the clean-up deletes <stem>.noisy.T.cal and <stem>.noisy.sd.T.cal but not <stem>.noisier.T.cal.
decisions.ours: Writes no Tsys table for any of the three.
decisions.rationale: The table is a by-product the task means to remove.
decisions.impact: CASA leaves a stray table in the project that casa-rs never creates.
decisions.owner_decision: Standing rule, AGENTS.md "CASA deviations" (owner, #1054): where CASA crashes, aborts, reads out of bounds, loses or corrupts data, or contradicts its documentation or evident intent, casa-rs corrects it.

decisions.record: simobserve's observing loop never ends for pointings of no length
decisions.inputs: simobserve with integration='0s' or a pointing file of zero times.
decisions.casa: The while (sttime-scanstart) < totalsec loop advances by each pointing's scan length; when a pass's lengths sum to zero the time never advances and CASA loops forever, collecting pointings.
decisions.ours: Refuses such a schedule with a message.
decisions.rationale: A schedule with no length cannot be observed.
decisions.impact: The task stops with an error instead of hanging.
decisions.owner_decision: Standing rule, AGENTS.md "CASA deviations" (owner, #1054): where CASA crashes, aborts, reads out of bounds, loses or corrupts data, or contradicts its documentation or evident intent, casa-rs corrects it.

decisions.record: simobserve deletes a sky model that is the model it writes
decisions.inputs: simobserve with skymodel given as the full path <project>/<stem>.skymodel (e.g. a rerun on an earlier run's model) and overwrite=True.
decisions.casa: The output is the input: CASA deletes the model and then fails to read it.
decisions.ours: Refuses the input, and the model is left in place.
decisions.rationale: The user's input must not be destroyed.
decisions.impact: The model survives and the user gets a clear refusal.
decisions.owner_decision: Standing rule, AGENTS.md "CASA deviations" (owner, #1054): where CASA crashes, aborts, reads out of bounds, loses or corrupts data, or contradicts its documentation or evident intent, casa-rs corrects it.

decisions.record: simobserve nests a project path inside itself
decisions.inputs: simobserve with project given as a path, e.g. 'a/b'.
decisions.casa: The task names files fileroot + '/' + project + '.' + cfg, so 'a/b' gives a/b/a/b.<cfg> in a directory that does not exist; only a plain name in the working directory works.
decisions.ours: Names files by the directory's last component, a/b/b.<cfg>.
decisions.rationale: For a plain name the two are the same.
decisions.impact: Project paths work in casa-rs and fail in CASA.

decisions.record: simobserve writes through a symbolic link in the project
decisions.inputs: simobserve overwrite=True in a project containing a symbolic link such as <stem>.ptg.txt.
decisions.casa: CASA copies ptgfile through the link, replacing the file the link points to outside the project, and creates outside files for dangling links; links to tables stop the task via rmtree; existence checks follow links.
decisions.ours: Replaces a link in the project with the new file or table, leaves the target alone, and counts a link as existing under overwrite=False.
decisions.rationale: Owner's decision of 2026-10-26: only the project's own files are replaced.
decisions.impact: Files outside the project are no longer overwritten or created through links.
decisions.owner_decision: Owner decision, 2026-10-26: the project's own files are the only ones overwrite replaces (recorded with the provider contracts' overwrite exception).

decisions.record: simobserve rounds a `direction` list of one to its mean
decisions.inputs: simobserve with direction=['J2000 18h00m00.123456789s ...'] (a list of one) versus the same direction as a string.
decisions.casa: CASA passes the list to calc_pointings2, and direction_splitter centres it at its mean written at precision 5, so the map is laid out about 1e-5 s of RA (0.15 mas) from the string case.
decisions.ours: casa-rs's simutil follows CASA, but simobserve treats a list of one like a string and lays the map out at the exact direction.
decisions.rationale: The task contract resolves a string to a list of one, and the rounding carries no information.
decisions.impact: A map is placed at the exact direction, differing from CASA by about 0.15 mas for a list of one.

casa-suite-20261103.kind: CASA's test_task_simobserve with casa-rs in place of CASA's task
casa-suite-20261103.result: Of the 54 cases CASA 6.7.6.14 passes on this host, casa-rs passes 45. Of the other 9, 3 refuse as CASA does in casa-rs's own words: an empty project, and comp_nchan and sdant of the wrong type. The other 6 are noise levels just outside the suite's 5% band: tsys-manual interferometer noise 5.8% below CASA's recorded value, and tsys-atm single-dish noise 5.05% above it in all five variants. Those six are CASA's own seed-11111 draws, which casa-rs's random stream cannot reproduce; over 20 seeds the levels agree to 0.5% (noise-seeds-20261103). 23 cases fail with CASA's own task too and 16 are skipped by both.
casa-suite-20261103.scope: CASA's own simobserve suite (93 cases): sky models, component lists, both, noise, bad inputs and correlators, judged by the suite's checks against casatestdata's reference products.

noise-seeds-20261103.result: The suite's two noise cases, 20 seeds each: casa-rs's mean level over CASA's is 1.002 for testNZ_sdAtm (tsys-atm single dish) and 1.005 for testNZ_intMan (tsys-manual interferometer), within 0.2 and 0.9 standard errors. The levels CASA's suite records are CASA's own seed-11111 draws, 1.8 and 2.9 of CASA's standard deviations from its mean, which a different random stream cannot reproduce: they explain the suite's six noise failures.
noise-seeds-20261103.scope: testNZ_sdAtm and testNZ_intMan of CASA's test_task_simobserve, the suite's noise level (noisy minus original, real part, standard deviation) per run.
